title: Unique Yeasty Vietnamese Pork Bun Rieu
description: This Vietnamese dish features a yeasty and crispy bun filled with pork, currants, and steamed vegetables, making it a perfect comfort food for a sick day. The combination of Mediterranean and Vietnamese flavors creates a unique taste experience.

ingredients.name: active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: make sure to activate before using

instructions: Activate the yeast by mixing it with warm water and letting it sit for 5 minutes.
Combine the flour, yeast mixture, and a pinch of salt to make the dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Prepare the filling by cooking the ground pork with chopped onion and sliced mushrooms.
Add the currants, fish sauce, and olive oil to the pork mixture and stir well.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and place a spoonful of the pork filling in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a bun and steam for 15 minutes using a mushimono steam method.
Serve the buns hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
